status: DECISION RECORD (W2 AREA, D-AREA), MODEL ESTIMATE: every area number is a courtyard sum computed by pcb/partition_budget.py into pcb/partition-budget.json; no placement, no proof-fit; hardware gates stay OPEN

decision.summary: Four main boards: PWR-A (plate-bonded L, 7910 mm2), PWR-B (mezzanine on the PWR-A footprint, Samtec QSH/QTH-060-01 5.00 mm stack), RF (unchanged) and a two-sided CTRL; harness headers consolidated per destination and exit zone. Working partition (a): the draft PWR-B list, with the LNB OVP comparator (U220 group) kept on PWR-A next to U212 so that E1_SW and the LNB LDO rail do not cross. Computed verdict (MODEL ESTIMATE): no evaluated partition fits at 1.8. Candidate (a) gives PWR-A 0.649 and PWR-B 0.448 (usable / demand), because every PWR-A part taller than hA and every PWR-A power header costs PWR-B a window or an edge strip (3.8k + 1.3k of the 7.6k outline). CTRL two-sided gives top 1.003 and bottom 0.979.
decision.why_a: (a) and (b) leave almost the same total shortfall (about 7.0k mm2 at 1.8), but (a) needs 53 B2B contacts against 76, moves no fused high-current internal net (E2_J21_FUSED) across the boards, and keeps the J21/display/Lime/AUX12 eFuses with their fuse holders and bulk capacitors; moving more groups to PWR-B overfills PWR-B, whose usable area is set by the windows
decision.shortfall_note: demand at 1.8 minus usable area, candidate (a), pcb/partition-budget.json; the PWR harness headers alone are 2.6k mm2 raw (about 4.7k at 1.8), two thirds of the PWR shortfall
rejected: (b) switch groups on PWR-B: PWR-A 0.713, PWR-B 0.383, 76 contacts and E2_J21_FUSED (4 A) across the boards

(c) Pololu modules off PWR-A on plate standoffs: PWR-A 0.733, PWR-B 0.723, still short, and no plate location exists (front face full, build/15 'Розмір'; behind the left leg sit the HF+ can and the RF bay, mechanical/generated/fit-report.md layout); a cut-out in the L for them saves nothing
bigger single PWR board or larger face: the face is fixed by the plan (D-ENV width unchanged, STACK.md:109 HMI layouts); depth growth adds no area
radials or headers on the RF board: RF max height 5.5 (mechanical/params/boards.json:91) and constraints DC-02/RF-01 (pcb/generated/constraints.json:37-77)
(h8) hB 8.0 instead of 5.5: PWR-A 0.660, PWR-B 0.515 for 2.5 mm more depth (dz_mezz 4.6); still short, and the radials (11.0-11.5 mm) stay above it
decision.next_decision: OPEN for INT/owner (integration_plan step 8, F2): the PWR function needs about 7.0k mm2 more board area at 1.8 than PWR-A + PWR-B give in the plan's face, or a smaller PWR connector/circuit set. GR-3, MECH-3 and the board packages implement (a) as the working partition; the real placement fill of PCB-PWRA-1/2 and PCB-PWRB is the trigger record.

b2b.rule: contacts per crossing power net = ceil(I_protection / b2b_i_pin_A), I_protection from tools/assembly_data.py NET_CURRENT or net_current_extra; every other crossing net 1 contact; plus gnd_pins_per_power_net; Kelvin and precision nets (shunt nets, INA inputs, precision divider mid-points) never cross except declared_sense_pairs and sense_taps; GR-3 writes pcb/generated/b2b-nets.json by the same rule

height_rule.rule: a PWR part goes to PWR-B only if its schematic group is in partition.PWR_B_groups and its read or class height (heights) is <= hB; otherwise it stays on PWR-A (DOMAIN_OVERRIDE). Every PWR-A part taller than hA gets a window in PWR-B (courtyard + window_margin each side); inside a window a PWR-A part may reach stack + board_t + hB = 12.1 mm
height_rule.pwr_b_header_rule: a PWR-B header takes the first family variant whose mated height is <= hB (side entry at hB 5.5); PWR-A headers sit in uncovered edge strips (courtyard + margin), because every one of them is taller than hA
height_rule.finding: at 72ee71b the THT radials EEU-FR1H470, UHE1E221MPD and EEU-FR1C101 (11.0-11.5 mm, LCSC read 2026-11-07) already exceed the PWR max_height 9.0 of mechanical/params/boards.json:28; under this rule they stay on PWR-A inside PWR-B windows (ceiling 12.1 mm), and MECH-3 gives the windows their height zone

keepouts.pwr_a_under_pwr_b_tht: no PWR-A component under any PWR-B THT pin field (pin field + window_margin each side; copper and mask allowed); the list is pcb/partition-budget.json candidates.<chosen>.pwr_a_keepout_items
keepouts.pwr_a_under_b2b: no PWR-A component under the mated QSH/QTH stack outside the QSH courtyard (counted as b2b_raw on both boards)
keepouts.pwr_a_tht_pockets: every PWR-A THT pad (candidates.<chosen>.pwr_a_tht_pocket_items: radials, Keystone 3568 holders, both Pololu pin rows, the PWR-A headers) gets a plate relief pocket >= 1.0 mm deep in M-07 plus a polyimide insulator over the 0.4 mm shim gap (mechanical/params/boards.json:36); MECH-3 draws them
